issue.title: Support other currencies
issue.body: We're planning a trip abroad next month and it would be great if this worked with other currencies.

comments.author: issue-pr-agent[bot]
comments.body:
I looked into this but need more information before I can make a change.

**Question**
What does "supporting other currencies" mean here: display formatting only, or conversion between currencies (and if so, with what exchange rates)?

comments.author: aaronpaddy
comments.body: Formatting only, no conversion. Show the right symbol for USD, EUR and GBP (e.g. €12.50), and let people pass a currency code.
